question: Which EV charging programs are open now?
html:
Two EV charging opportunities on our list are still open as of Oct 19, 2026. They are the MassDOT NEVI developers' installer call, open to Oct 31, 2026, and Cambridge neighborhood EV charging, due Nov 10, 2026 (CET opportunity radar). The SRTA New Bedford DCFC bid closed on Oct 9, 2026.

Open and recently closed

OpportunityOwnerDueStatus Oct 19
NEVI installer call (Global Montello / Applegreen memo)MassDOT NEVI developersOct 31, 2026Open
Cambridge neighborhood EV charging (federal-aid)City of CambridgeNov 10, 2026Open
New Bedford DCFC installSRTAOct 9, 2026Closed

What each one involves

  • NEVI installer call. MassDOT's NEVI developers are asking for installer partners. Responding puts CET in line for DC fast-charger installs on Massachusetts highway sites (CET opportunity radar).
  • Maine NEVI follow-on. Applegreen also holds 2026 Maine NEVI awards. The radar suggests offering it the same installer partnership. That could become a multi-state DCFC install pipeline (est.). This is an outreach opportunity, not a posted bid with a deadline.
  • Cambridge neighborhood charging. This is a federal-aid municipal project. The radar says to check MassDOT prequalification and DBE requirements early (CET opportunity radar). Owners set those terms, so confirm them with the owner directly.

Limits of this list

  • The radar was generated on Sep 24, 2026. Statuses may have changed since then.
  • The radar holds 86 items, and only part of it is shown here. Other EV items may exist.
  • COMMBUYS, RI Purchasing and NH DAS blocked automated access. Massachusetts, Rhode Island and New Hampshire charging bids may therefore be undercounted.
  • Contract values for these EV items are not in the radar. Owner bid documents or the developers' scopes would provide them.

EV depot charging is one of the Phase 3 lines meant to turn one-off installs into recurring service contracts. PKF and Capstone price that service mix 3 or more turns above project-heavy contractors, against a target of about 25% recurring mix by month 36 (est., CET growth plan).

Next actions

  1. Send the NEVI installer response to the MassDOT developers before Oct 31, 2026. Use the same package to approach Applegreen about its Maine awards.
  2. Confirm CET's MassDOT prequalification status and the Cambridge bid's DBE terms with the owner this week. Then assign an estimator for the Nov 10, 2026 deadline.
  3. Ask SRTA for the New Bedford DCFC bid results and plan holders. Use that list to judge pricing and competitors for depot work.
  4. Check COMMBUYS and the RI and NH portals by hand for EV charging solicitations the radar could not reach.
